state_dimensions.read: Feature state through the tracked Rust console product backend; independent driver evidence is recorded separately in baseline_notes. A UI label or metadata alone does not prove hardware state.
state_dimensions.write: Authorized feature-specific mutation, separately from an OS power policy or unrelated control.
state_dimensions.readback: Post-write observation; an echoed request does not prove physical effect.
state_dimensions.recovery: Conditional restoration of verified prior state, preserving later external changes and reporting partial failure.

state_dimensions.loading: Exact active driver/helper/service identity; disk installation is insufficient.

来源、兼容、恢复和交付待补；不在本索引中授权刷写。

features.name: 应用自动绑定方案
baseline_notes: 原厂入口与独立TCC功能已有，Rust尚未接入。
schema、应用匹配、优先级、AC/DC及持久化待实现。

features.name: GUI、CLI、托盘、OSD、IPC、服务安装
baseline_notes: Linux原生概览与CLI已安装并有只读记录。
托盘、OSD、完整服务、权限、升级和双端OEM控制待完成。

linux_progress.scope: Partial subcapabilities only; full family remains incomplete.
linux_progress.candidate_hardware_scope: Local GM6PX0X only; requested-state readback and restoration.
limitations: Native run confirmed four OEM selectors and the Fn-lock panel only; the other three panels, preview/apply and authentication dialog were not exercised.
Tray, OSD and the complete service family remain incomplete.
Installed root pkexec acceptance toggled/restored Fn only; normal-user administrator dialog and GUI apply remain unverified. Prepared r158 kernel code is still not loaded.
linux_progress.installed_helper_runtime: One-shot helper was executed for Fn and exited; not a daemon and no helper/pkexec process remained.
linux_progress.record_scope: Historical four-control OEM candidate and r160 installed Fn acceptance. Later installations and their own smoke scopes are recorded separately in current_work.latest_deployment and historical deployment fields; old write results are not transferred.

thermal_sampling_progress.count_scope: Whole workspace total, not added to other historical suites or counted per family
thermal_sampling_progress.candidate_cli_read_scope: Three actual read-only candidate CLI frames with 33 hwmon temperature/fan readings per frame; trace: 1 execve, 0 ioctl, 0 writable opens, 0 forbidden discovery opens
thermal_sampling_progress.gui_scope: Candidate 1280x720 isolated Linux startup/overview and keyboard navigation to unprobed no-draft fan page verified; no actual desktop, lease, Apply, Restore, native graceful-close or physical-effect acceptance
thermal_sampling_progress.windows_scope: Compile check only; dedicated thermal sampler explicitly unavailable

brightness_deployment.scope: Installed r171 brightness subset only. Offline candidate suites and historical r168 CPU acceptance retain separate scopes; no complete feature family or upstream issue is closed.
brightness_deployment.installed_cli_scope: Two explicit ordinary-user brightness setters through the installed CLI and linux_logind session 3 / seat0. Requested and driver-reported actual raw values read back; not optical luminance acceptance.
brightness_deployment.installed_native_gui_scope: One 70% brightness preview in an isolated private D-Bus / Cage overview, visually checked. Preview raw 67200 to 67200; bounded before/after requested and actual endpoint reads stayed 67200. No slider change, Apply, authorization or OEM/fan operation.

windows_fnlock_progress.implemented: Native fixed EC transport, complete-byte transaction and conditional recovery, independent firmware/driver qualification, authenticated UAC pipe, helper lifetime/wait, shared mutex and persistent maintenance gate, CLI and GUI explicit probe/preview/apply wiring.
windows_fnlock_progress.support: One fixed candidate contract; candidate compile feature off by default; zero runtime_accepted contracts.
windows_fnlock_progress.verification: 519 all-feature Rust and 140 Python console checks plus compile-only Windows target verification; MinGW maintenance DLL compile/link is separate from MSVC or WiX/MSI.
windows_fnlock_progress.scope: Source/offline subset only. No Windows MSI build, UAC, installation/maintenance, native GUI or hardware acceptance; full feature family remains incomplete.

historical_r171_installation_state.scope: Original r171 current fields retained when the later r174 package/read-only smoke became current; r171 brightness write/preview proof remains in brightness_deployment.

os_profile_fan_candidate.system_profile_scope: Linux PPD read/Set and GUI source wiring; service identity/holds bound before apply; no automatic retry/rollback after Set, and no live-service acceptance.
os_profile_fan_candidate.minimum_fan_output_scope: Explicit optional selected-channel duty floors on a complete validated user curve, default None; preserve zero unless explicitly allowed. Not RPM, OEM presets or noise/thermal qualification.
os_profile_fan_candidate.verification_scope: 580 all-features Rust, 143 Python console and 579 actual Linux release-feature tests passed on the frozen 95-input snapshot. Candidate pure-function mutations retain their scope. No native lease or physical acceptance.
os_profile_fan_candidate.record_scope: Historical source/offline candidate scope; later r177 Linux installation is separate.

historical_r174_installation_state.scope: Prior r174 installation/runtime fields retained unchanged; not transferred to r177.

features.name: 仪表盘、磁盘、网络、进程工具
baseline_notes: 当前只有部分真实传感器。
完整指标、成本与原厂对应应用流程待补，不能默默缩减范围。

thermal_sampling_progress.count_scope: Whole workspace total, not added to other historical suites or counted per family
thermal_sampling_progress.candidate_cli_read_scope: Three actual read-only candidate CLI frames with 33 hwmon temperature/fan readings per frame; trace: 1 execve, 0 ioctl, 0 writable opens, 0 forbidden discovery opens
thermal_sampling_progress.gui_scope: Candidate 1280x720 isolated Linux startup/overview and keyboard navigation to unprobed no-draft fan page verified; no actual desktop, lease, Apply, Restore, native graceful-close or physical-effect acceptance
thermal_sampling_progress.windows_scope: Compile check only; dedicated thermal sampler explicitly unavailable

features.name: 音频响应RGB、音量、静音
baseline_notes: 原厂入口与Linux基础设施是研究线索，不是完整效果。
音频协议、采集权限、实体灯光与静音事件待验。

features.name: 键盘重映射、宏
baseline_notes: 内核键事件不等于应用宏。
配置、应用匹配、快捷键优先级、权限、回滚和UI待实现。

features.name: AI、OpenVINO、游戏监控
baseline_notes: 原厂类型/入口存在；不能推定算法已经使用或不适用。
实际模型、数据、native依赖、策略和效果待调查。

issue_groups.name: 身份与能力
acceptance: 身份、固件与后端独立判定；未知和冲突不串配。
缺驱动、权限不足与不支持分开；不静默提供模拟硬件数据。

issue_groups.name: CPU与性能模式
acceptance: OS电源方案、OEM模式与实际硬件限制分别表达。
AC/DC、空闲、负载与其他写入者冲突有实际回读；部分失败可恢复。

issue_groups.name: 双风扇
acceptance: 自动、手动、全速和曲线所有权明确。
独立/同步、升/降速、部分失败与恢复核对真实RPM及固件约束。

issue_groups.name: 电池限充
acceptance: 档位、阈值和主动放电分开，实际停止/恢复充电。
重启、AC变化、睡眠保持；不修改性能灯及其他字段。

issue_groups.name: 睡眠恢复
acceptance: 唤醒后重探测实际设备和状态，按依赖恢复。
单项失败不阻断其余功能；重复睡眠后核对负载和风扇。

issue_groups.name: 灯光
acceptance: 逐控制器验证能力、关灯、亮度、效果与欢迎模式。
闲置、合盖、AC/DC和退出交接均验证实体状态。

issue_groups.name: Fn与状态灯
acceptance: 逐键映射、指示灯、重复事件及睡眠回归。
保留上游历史版本及已恢复反馈，不算本项目修复。

issue_groups.name: GPU模式与超频
acceptance: 拓扑和固件支持明确；禁用功能零写入。
内屏、HDMI、USB-C、重启和可执行恢复方案均验收。

issue_groups.name: 固件与系统开关
acceptance: 接电开机通过真实冷接电验收。
睡眠策略针对当前活动方案正确AC/DC项，写后回读、恢复。

issue_groups.name: 遥测
acceptance: 每个设备绑定ID、单位、来源、时间和有效性。
陈旧、无效、休眠与计数器重置不伪造零；外电和充放电分开。

issue_groups.name: 后台与生命周期
acceptance: UI不等待硬件；单查询、超时、退避、取消与退出回收。
实际测量CPU、内存、子进程、界面延迟与GPU唤醒。

issue_groups.name: 显示与色彩
acceptance: 逐屏能力、ICC关联、实际校准和增强状态分别表示。
刷新率不触碰色彩；方案管理、重启/睡眠恢复均可验。

issue_groups.name: 恢复与副作用
acceptance: 保存原值及所有权，保护用户后续修改与第三方GPU设置。
配置迁移、官方软件接回和部分恢复失败报告真实结果。

issue_groups.name: 界面与快捷操作
acceptance: 多方案、可选模式循环、快捷键、窗口记忆及自定义亮度可持久化。
字体/不透明选项可读；DPI、小窗、底边场景所有操作可达。

issue_groups.name: 分发与导出
acceptance: Windows/Linux构建可复现；启动、更新和失败恢复状态真实。
导出处理中文、空格、缺目录、权限与既有目标，返回真实路径。

issue_groups.name: BLE水冷
acceptance: 水泵和排风扇独立控制，固定水泵策略有明确支持依据。
阈值附近不反复启停；失联、重连与实体泵状态验收，不猜最低PWM。

issues.title: [Feature]: 多个自定义方案，可以在托盘右键切换
issues.acceptance: 自定义方案可在快捷入口直接切换并隐藏不用的默认方案；持久化且验证切换后的实际状态。

issues.title: [Bug]: 自定义方案CPU始终跑满限制的功耗
issues.acceptance: 自定义模式的功耗上限不变成强制最低负载；空闲和负载分别核验电源策略，不凭报告猜根因。

issues.title: [Bug]: 前端页面渲染丢失
issues.acceptance: 快速重复开关托盘窗口不丢失渲染；硬件探测失败时窗口仍可操作并显示错误。

issues.title: [Bug]: 24年蛟龙16pro 7745 4070 无法使用
issues.acceptance: 正确辨别宝龙达蛟龙16Pro及后端能力；不把其无法使用直接归为与缺驱动死锁相同根因。

issues.title: [Bug]: 控制台CPU负载和频率与实际数据差异巨大
issues.acceptance: CPU负载与频率明确采样来源、时间和单位；计数器重置或缺失不产生伪数据。

issues.title: [Bug/RFC]: 卸载官方控制台后 \.\ACPIDriver 缺失导致 UI 主线程死锁（托盘无响应根因分析与纯净自愈方案）
issues.acceptance: 缺失ACPI驱动快速报告不可用，探测不阻塞UI，无无限同步重试；安装驱动不是普通探测的隐式副作用。

issues.title: [Bug]: 使用机型数据收集专用版一键导出至桌面失败
issues.acceptance: 报告导出支持显式路径及系统桌面位置，覆盖重定向目录、中文空格和权限失败，不伪报成功。

issues.title: [Bug]:数据采集问题PL4功耗低很多导致CPU性能释放低
issues.acceptance: PL1/PL2/PL4的单位及范围各有型号证据，回读不混淆字段；不直接采纳报告中的420W为通用值。

issues.title: [Feature]: 记住窗口显示模式
issues.acceptance: 显示模式持久化并在重新启动后恢复；损坏配置有明确回退且不影响硬件设置。

issues.title: [Feature]: 换个更好看的图标
issues.acceptance: 图标在托盘、高DPI及深浅背景下可辨认，透明背景与尺寸资源正确。

issues.title: [Feature]: 性能模式的更多快捷按钮
issues.acceptance: 用户自定义方案可直接选择并保持顺序；无效或不支持方案显示原因而非假成功。

issues.title: [Bug]: README.md 开发版本部署 ISSUE
issues.acceptance: 文档使用真实仓库和存在的目录；Windows/Linux从干净检出按记录命令构建并验证。

issues.title: [Feature]: 为40系机型增加狂暴模式显卡OC开关
issues.acceptance: GPU超频能力及范围按具体型号验证；未启用时零写入，退出模式按已记录原值恢复。

issues.title: [Bug]: 电源重新断开后重新插入键盘灯光自动切换
issues.acceptance: 电源状态变化保留明确选择的灯效；只在策略显式要求时切换，并回读实际效果。

issues.title: [Bug]: 30系机械革命切换核显模式黑屏，无法进入Windows/bios
issues.acceptance: 未验证的GPU/MUX切换在精确型号能力校验前拒绝；保留恢复依据，不能以模拟测试证明黑屏根因已修复。

issues.title: [Bug]: 无界15X 8845HS 只能切换办公/均衡模式，Fn等功能映射异常
issues.acceptance: 无界15XA的背光档位、灯区、Fn及温度字段按独立证据建模；PD模式限制明确来源，不猜字段单位。

issues.title: [Bug]: 无法恢复官方控制台
issues.acceptance: 保存接管前服务及配置状态；恢复官方控制台逐步验证，失败保留恢复材料和准确原因。

issues.title: [Docs]: 文档中明确可支持的型号和功能边界
issues.acceptance: 支持清单按型号、功能、操作系统及验证级别记录，未验证或不支持功能可见且不可误操作。

issues.title: [Bug]: 无界14X 8845HS 功能异常
issues.acceptance: 无界14XA按准确型号提供能力；CPU/GPU读数、风扇通道、功耗支持与界面型号分别验证。

issues.title: [Bug]: miniled控光算法导致的大面积光晕
issues.acceptance: MiniLED算法与面板能力分开验证，以相同测试图对比实际光晕；未验证面板不写控制参数。

issues.title: [Feature]: 选择性禁用 自定义 调度模式
issues.acceptance: 可从模式循环排除不支持或未启用的自定义方案；按键循环不重新启用已排除方案。

issues.title: [Bug] 校色状态“未校准”的判断与 Windows 系统色彩管理不明确
issues.acceptance: 分别显示配置文件安装、显示器关联、曲线加载和本项目开关状态，提供由系统管理及恢复路径。

issues.title: [Feature]: 全屏模式CUP信息显示不完整+缺少快捷开关+海岸灯条不工作
issues.acceptance: 长CPU名称不截断；触摸板切换键与触摸板状态独立，海岸灯条先确认硬件连接与能力。

issues.title: [Feature]: 锁定充电上限数额回退
issues.acceptance: 充电上限与主动放电能力分开；不支持主动放电时明确说明，不将阈值设置伪装成放电功能。

issues.title: [Feature]: 性能监控 悬浮面板
issues.acceptance: 性能面板快捷键可配置并处理冲突；指标绑定对应设备且采样不可用时明确显示。

issues.title: [Bug]: 显卡功耗读取异常
issues.acceptance: 按设备与来源验证GPU功耗单位、可用性和有效边界；异常值不冒充真实功耗，NVAPI/NVML不串来源。

issues.title: [Bug]: 翼龙15Pro2024是双显三模被识别为双显双模
issues.acceptance: 显卡模式列表来自精确型号的已验证能力；未验证iGPU模式不开放危险切换。

issues.title: [Feature]: 监控悬浮窗 和 快捷键
issues.acceptance: 面板显示带单位的CPU/GPU即时功耗，快捷键可配置；不可用读数不显示零。

issues.title: [bug]: 狂暴模式与官方狂暴模式性能释放差异
issues.acceptance: 对应极光Pro在相同供电、散热与负载下比较官方和本项目模式；记录实际限制与回读，不猜功耗值。

issues.title: [feature]: 显卡设置默认覆盖msi afterbunner。能否默认不开启显卡设置，尤其是在应用未开启任何显卡设置的条件下
issues.acceptance: 关闭GPU调节时启动及模式切换均不写GPU参数；第三方调节保持不变，以后端命令记录核验。

issues.title: [Feature]: 屏幕色彩增强的管理功能
issues.acceptance: 色彩方案支持导入导出、删除和重命名，非法文件和同名冲突安全失败且保留现有方案。

issues.title: [Bug]: 更新open-revo-v0.8.6.2后充电上限功能失效与存在文字显示bug
issues.acceptance: 重启后重新验证实际充电阈值，配置迁移与失败恢复可测试；乱码和充电问题分别跟踪历史反馈。

issues.title: [Feature]: 电池循环次数.电源推荐方案及非透明UI
issues.acceptance: 循环次数缺失显示不可用，支持可读非透明外观；离电策略与Windows电源模式关系明确。

issues.title: [Bug]: 24款翼龙15pro官方控制台无法重新接管屏幕校色和电池充电上限
issues.acceptance: 接管前保留颜色关联和充电设置；恢复后由官方控制台接管，并验证关联及充电状态。

issues.title: [Bug]: 高性能电源模式切换异常
issues.acceptance: 自定义模式的Windows电源策略与用户选择和提示一致；逐模式测试，关闭功能时不改电源方案。

issues.title: [Bug]: 锁充电上限、屏幕色彩切换、A面logo灯关闭均失效
issues.acceptance: 分别核验PD在线、充电阈值、校色及Logo能力；逐项回读，不用一个成功标志覆盖多项失败。

issues.title: [Feature]: 后台webview占用资源太多了，希望后台时能自动杀掉webview进程
issues.acceptance: 隐藏界面降低渲染和采样开销；恢复窗口仍能获取最新状态，测量后台内存与CPU。

issues.title: [BUG]：灯光问题
issues.acceptance: 欢迎模式、Logo颜色及海岸灯带效果分通道验证，保存与实际回读一致，不假定灯区通用。

issues.title: [Feature]: 增加更新功能
issues.acceptance: 更新检查区分网络错误、无更新和新版本；下载校验与原子替换可恢复，版本比较不混淆压缩包扩展名。

issues.title: [Bug]: 托盘退出后无可见主进程，但替换新版文件后双击无法直接启动
issues.acceptance: 退出取消后台任务并释放句柄及单实例锁；替换文件后可直接启动，不残留阻塞子进程。

issues.title: [Bug]: 无法开机自启
issues.acceptance: 自启动设置后读取真实注册状态，重启登录核验；权限或任务创建失败明确显示。

issues.title: [Bug]: 调整为均衡/狂暴/自定义后，CPU异常高温高频
issues.acceptance: 空闲与负载分别验证各性能模式的系统电源策略及频率；不将报告中未复现的根因当结论。

issues.title: [Bug]: Intel 平台 PPM 开启时，混合显卡模式最高睿频被限制为小核频率
issues.acceptance: Intel大小核睿频上限分别读取并明确单位；PPM在混合和独显模式下不误用小核上限。

issues.title: [Bug]: RGB灯光欢迎模式设置不了
issues.acceptance: 欢迎灯效保存、预览与重启后的实际效果一致；保存失败不得保留成功状态。

issues.title: [Feature]: 重构后台查询机制并尽快开放源码
issues.acceptance: 后台查询使用适合常驻的API，单提供者最多一个查询，失败退避并可取消，避免高频外部进程。

issues.title: [Bug]: 高负载时键盘灯光闪烁
issues.acceptance: 高负载下灯光更新不竞争硬件访问且不意外熄灭；以压力下命令时序与实机录像核验。

issues.title: [Bug]: 切换屏幕刷新率会自动打开屏幕色彩校正
issues.acceptance: 刷新率修改不触发未启用的校色操作；校色开关与实际状态一致，单项变更可回归。

issues.title: [Feature]: 使用软件后出现异常问题，如何退回？
issues.acceptance: 提供变更记录与可恢复原值；恢复结果逐项回读，未知或恢复失败不得声称完全退回。

issues.title: [Bug]: 状态灯不对，Fn+F5无法切换触控板
issues.acceptance: 26款蛟龙16Pro的性能灯及Fn触摸板映射按型号验证，操作失败有可见状态。

issues.title: [Bug]: 键盘关闭背光闪烁情况
issues.acceptance: 关闭背光后不被后台刷新意外重开；记录命令序列并在耀世16Pro反复观察。

issues.title: [Bug]:重启或者休眠回来后屏幕色彩校正就会失效，但是app里开关还是处于打开状态
issues.acceptance: 重启和睡眠后区分用户意图与实际校色状态；恢复失败明确显示而非只保留打开开关。

issues.title: [Bug]: 来电自动开机失效
issues.acceptance: AC自动开机写前保留可恢复原值并回读；恢复官方控制后状态可核验，不猜测EC位。

issues.title: [Bug]: 无界14Pro会被辨识成蛟龙16Pro
issues.acceptance: 无界14Pro7840HS不匹配蛟龙16Pro；歧义匹配拒绝写入，展示识别依据与能力。

issues.title: [Feature]: 添加风扇转速同步功能
issues.acceptance: 风扇同步模式有明确曲线选择及双通道输出；独立与同步切换不遗留旧目标。

issues.title: [Bug]: 键盘灯光不熄灭
issues.acceptance: 闲置超时后背光真实熄灭且活动后恢复；在耀世16Pro与Windows10实机验证。

issues.title: [Bug]:蛟龙16pro 锁定充电上限导致性能模式灯效错乱
issues.acceptance: 充电阈值操作不生成性能指示灯写入；对应蛟龙16Pro核对模式与灯色映射。

issues.title: [Bug]: 24款翼龙15pro性能模式切换无效
issues.acceptance: 模式切换后读取实际硬件状态；对应翼龙15Pro验证各档负载表现，不以UI标签代替生效。

issues.title: [Bug]: 睡眠守护中忽略系统所需策略的开关貌似无效
issues.acceptance: 对当前电源计划的AC/DC目标项进行读改回读，开关语义一致，失败不显示已生效。

issues.title: [Bug]: 用100W PD充电时电源管理界面显示正在使用电池供电
issues.acceptance: 外部电源在线与电池充放电分开报告；100W PD证据冲突显示未知，不直接误报仅电池供电。

issues.title: [Feature]: 希望添加快捷键
issues.acceptance: 可绑定模式及面板快捷键，冲突和注册失败明确显示；重启后配置保留。

issues.title: [Bug]: cpu占用率异常
issues.acceptance: 后台降低采样，避免无必要唤醒独显；记录CPU/内存和GPU活动并验证界面切换响应。

issues.title: 键盘灯光控制问题
issues.acceptance: 灯效设置立即生效且亮度调整不是必要条件；拔插电源不意外重置用户灯效，逐效果实机验收。

issues.title: [Bug]: 校色文件异常
issues.acceptance: 校色变更可恢复，视频及桌面显示分别核对；没有对应屏幕证据不提供假定校色文件。

issues.title: [Bug]: Fn 功能键错位（v0.9.1 功能已正常）
issues.acceptance: 保留无界14XA逐项Fn键映射回归；区分0.8.8/0.8.9历史报告与上游0.9.1已恢复反馈。

issues.title: [Bug]: 耀世16pro没有A面灯效设置
issues.acceptance: 耀世16Pro2024的A面灯能力来自独立证据；有支持则可设置并回读，无支持明确说明。

issues.title: [Bug]: MECHREVO 深海泰坦 X3-S (GK7MR0R, 20系/RTX2060) 无法匹配任何机型清单，永久落入 MockHAL (SAFE MOCK)
issues.acceptance: 明确GK7MR0R的匹配和后端探测原因；没有通路时显示不可用而非真实模拟值，不按前缀推断写协议。

issues.title: [Feature]:解除离电限制开启下拔电后可自定义模式切换的建议
issues.acceptance: 允许显式配置离电后的性能模式；AC断开和恢复按策略切换，未知供电状态不盲目提高功耗。

issues.title: [Bug]: 耀世15pro i9-13900hx4060睡眠唤醒后cpu/gpu功率异常
issues.acceptance: 睡眠唤醒后重新探测能力和真实功耗状态；恢复失败可见，在对应耀世15Pro重复睡眠负载验收。

issues.title: [Bug]: 迷你窗口布局有问题 下面的两个按钮显示不出来
issues.acceptance: 小屏、DPI变化和屏幕底边场景下内容可滚动，底部按钮可见可操作；溢出依据实际视口。

issues.title: [Bug]: 24蛟龙16pro风扇控制异常
issues.acceptance: 风扇曲线及手动升降均有回读与状态依据；验证CPU/GPU双通道，明确固件保护下限。

issues.title: [Feature]: UI字体有点显小了
issues.acceptance: 支持可读字体缩放；在27寸2K与不同DPI下核对文字、按钮和布局。

issues.title: [Bug]: 无法熄灯
issues.acceptance: 闲置超时与合盖事件正确关闭背光，活动恢复遵循原设定；在耀世16Ultra实机验收。

issues.title: [Bug]: 机械革命钛钽plus 11800h 3060 所有版本充电上限锁不住
issues.acceptance: 钛钽PLUS对应型号明确充电阈值支持状态，写后回读并验证真实充电停止；不承诺修复非控制台掉电。

issues.title: [Bug]: 翼龙15pro 8845hs+4070版本状态总览显示的gpu状态功耗不准
issues.acceptance: 核显与独显以稳定设备ID分别展示功耗等指标；枚举顺序变化不串卡，不混合来源。

issues.title: [Feature]: 屏幕亮度自定义预设
issues.acceptance: 支持保存和重新应用自定义亮度；校验范围，保存失败不得显示成功。

issues.title: [Feature]: 建议把水冷的智能控制调整为不关闭水泵
issues.acceptance: 提供水泵固定、风扇独立调节策略；温度在阈值附近波动时不反复启停，实机核对水泵状态。

issues.title: [Bug]: 机械革命17kscpu功耗锁不住80w只有65w
issues.acceptance: 报告目标功耗、实际回读和限制原因；在17KS对应硬件验证80W请求的支持边界，不伪报已锁定。

index_validation.method: Constructed group mapping from explicit requirements; asserted exact set equality with data/openrevo-issues.json, unique issue numbers, one group per issue, 28 contiguous feature IDs and valid feature group references.

implementation_order.name: Existing verified Linux driver interfaces
deliverables: Discover actual capabilities and exposed nodes without adding model white-list guesses.
Wire charging profiles, supported lighting/Fn controls and qualified optional switches through shared CLI/GUI plans and restricted helper.
Verify writes, readback, permission failures, stale plans and conditional recovery.

implementation_order.name: OEM power and fan transactions
deliverables: Obtain model-specific range and ownership evidence.
Complete dual-channel, curve, partial-failure and event restoration tests.
Verify real RPM, noise, thermals and load on the exact active driver.

implementation_order.name: Telemetry and resource behavior
deliverables: Separate physical GPUs, cached/unknown states and power-supply evidence.
Measure idle/background CPU, memory, child processes, UI latency and GPU wake behavior.

implementation_order.name: Daily control surface
deliverables: Tray, OSD, shortcuts, AC/DC memory and application profiles.
Display and peripheral controls with per-device readback/recovery.

implementation_order.name: Windows parity backend
deliverables: Validate independent driver binding, ABI, permissions and real hardware read/write/recovery.
Reuse behavior contracts; do not substitute Linux acceptance or Windows compilation.

implementation_order.name: Accessories and firmware
deliverables: Qualify exact BLE/lighting/firmware protocols and compatible hardware.
Keep unqualified or unavailable accessories and research-only features open in the scope.

verified_interpretation_limits.finding: Reported 80W request versus 65W result; no established MSR periodic rewrite or EC timeout cause.
Reported ineffective fan curves/lowering; missing latch is not an independently confirmed cause.
Reported resume anomaly; all-register reset and a fixed 1.5-second replay delay are not established.
Fixed-pump policy is requested; no universally safe minimum PWM is provided.
Author reports Fn mapping normal in upstream v0.9.1. This is upstream feedback, not a fix or physical acceptance by this project.
Later feedback reports garbling solved and charge limits mostly working but possibly lost after reboot; split these acceptance items.
Maintainer relates #6 to the startup issue but attributes #7 to Baolongda identification; do not collapse them into one confirmed cause.
User-reported black-screen and reverse-engineering hypotheses require independent qualification; not hardware protocol authorization.

update_policy: Never infer a completion percentage from static analysis, test counts or installed packages.
Missing accessories or protocols remain open qualification tasks, not silently removed scope.
Record implementation, tests, installation, active loading and physical acceptance separately for each platform.
Do not mark an upstream issue resolved solely because this architecture avoids one failure class.
Attach immutable source and evidence references when changing state; retain historical receipts instead of rewriting them.
